'''Core Health and Life Insurance Consortium''' was an insurance company that offered health and life insurances.<ref name="MF" />

The [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Tobb Jadak]] had a health policy taken out for him by the [[Republic Group/Legends|Republic Group]].<ref name="MF" />
